title: Need 4 teammates for the KuCoin Broker League. We're already top 3, and you just need 1K volume
author: linandel
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I'm entered in the KuCoin Broker League: Global Trading Clash and I'm looking for a few people to fill out my team.

Where things stand: My AI-powered trading system has already done over 6,300,000 USDT in trading volume, which puts our team in the top 3 on the leaderboard as of Sep 22. At our current pace, we're on track to take 1st place. The volume requirement is already covered. The only thing missing is the minimum headcount: a team needs at least 5 eligible members, so I need 4 more people. Join now and you're on a top-3 team from day one.

What you'd need to do:

Join the team through my link below
Trade at least 1,000 USDT in volume during the event (that's the per-member minimum)

That's it. My AI trader carries the volume, and you only need to meet the minimum to count as an eligible member. You'll be eligible for a share of the 20,000 USDT reward if we hit rank 1.

Event details:

🏆 50,000 USDT total prize pool, 20,000 USDT for 1st place
🏅 The top 20 qualifying teams share the pool, ranked by total team volume
📅 Runs Sep 16, 16:00 to Oct 16, 15:59 (UTC)

Join the team here:
https://link.kucoin.com/iqEP/4g6oboys?activityId=KA_teamcup_brokerleague&inviteTeam=10041820&campaignId=ka_teamcup_brokerleague0917&campaignType=1&rcode=CXEV84YA&utm_source=competition&appNeedLang=true

Please check KuCoin's official event page for the exact reward distribution and eligibility rules. As always, only trade what you're comfortable with.

Drop a comment or DM me if you have questions. Thanks!
